Name: Overgrown Areas
Author: sadnumbme
Description:
Configurable Makes Backwoods, Mountain Linus's area, Railroad, and Cindersnap Forest overgrown. 

Paths are still clear. Trees will grow back after being cut down. For an existing save you might need to use reset terrain features. 
 https://github.com/Lake1059/ResetTerrainFeatures_NET6/releases

I hope you enjoy this mod and take a look at my others.
